label: Bible Study
prompt: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul _____ for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verse: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
note: A psalm of David 'in the wilderness of Judah' — the dry land outside matched the thirst inside.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not _____ any more at all.
verse: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
note: Returning exiles singing on Zion's heights, souls like a watered garden — and no more sorrow at all.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's _____?
verse: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
note: After a three-day search, Jesus' first recorded words: he had to be about his Father's business.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was _____ in those days; there was no open vision.
verse: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.
note: In Eli's day God rarely spoke — which is why young Samuel didn't recognize the voice calling him at night.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: _____ not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verse: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
note: Gethsemane's hinge word: 'nevertheless not as I will' — the prayer that turned the night toward the cross.
